a8443719a3597c62.description:
What We Do
Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.
Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.
We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are
Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.
The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.
Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.
Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need
We are building an accounting & finance software that will be industry-defining, and we need someone to help Rillet transition to the next company phase. We’ve grown quickly over the past few months and are expanding our GTM team to accelerate this trajectory. You’ll work directly with the CEO, the GTM, and the Product teams to help prospects evaluate Rillet as their next ERP. As an early member of Rillet's GTM team, you’ll be uniquely positioned to build strategies, test hypotheses, and lay the foundation for Rillet’s GTM motion for the future.
We’re primarily looking for teammates within commutable distance of our New York City or San Francisco offices, or those willing to relocate. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States.
Office-based team members work in person Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day. Certain roles may require more in-office time based on the needs of the function.

What You'll Do
• 
Remove technical objections
You’ll play a key role in the sales cycle by addressing all technical questions of potential customers. Specifically, you’ll understand their business requirements and existing technology stack, clearly articulate how Rillet will be integrated, and improve their processes. You’ll take part in sales conversations and will be able to answer the vast majority of technical questions immediately, without the need to circle back with the Product team.
• 
Perform sales demonstrations
You’ll set up the sandbox environment and tailor the data to showcase each customer's key specific use cases. You’ll deliver high-impact demonstrations, answering questions along the way and adapting based on the customer’s needs. You’ll be their consultant in the purchase process.
• 
Execute relentlessly
Work cross-functionally to provide front-line prospect feedback to founders and product teams in close to real-time. You will experiment with different demo styles, help write thoughtful follow-ups to customers, and become a highly responsive advisor to our prospective customers. You’ll roll up your sleeves and accelerate velocity.
• 
Represent Rillet
You’ll be the face of the company and will apply high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every prospect interaction is delightful. You’re comfortable marketing to a user with high finance and accounting proficiency, and your knowledge about the domain will be furthered in the process.

Who We're Looking For
• 
3+ years of industry accounting experience, involving various accounting areas including revenue recognition, month-end close, and multi-entity consolidation.
• 
2+ years of experience supporting the sales cycle with implementation and/or customer support for accounting/financial solutions.
• 
Knowledge of the ecosystem of tools in the office of the CFO.
• 
Excellent communicator who can make complex concepts easy to understand and knows how to write and speak conversationally.
• 
Thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment while keeping a high attention to detail.
• 
CPA certification or having started your career in audit, a plus.

The expected base salary range for this role varies by location:
Tier A: OTE $200,000 – $280,000
Your compensation tier is based on your primary work location. You can view Rillet’s compensation zones here.
Final compensation within the applicable range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.
 
Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet
• 
Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.
• 
Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.
• 
Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.
• 
Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.
Compensation: $200K – $280K
• Zone A • OTE $200K – $280K

Headquarters: New York, NY
 
URL: https://animalz.co

We are looking for a freelance developmental editor to review B2B SaaS content written by our in-house and freelance writers. You’ll focus on long-form content, from SEO/AEO/GEO to thought leadership, though editors are occasionally called upon to review copy for LinkedIn, landing pages, or other formats. 

Editors at Animalz play a key role in ensuring the work we deliver meets our internal bar for quality and helps our clients meet their business goals. You sit between writers and copyeditors, and while you should be able to edit prose at the line level, your primary focus is editing for substance. Does the piece of content you’re editing effectively execute the brief? Is it aligned with the client’s business goals and tailored for their audience? Is it structurally and logically sound? 

To ensure each piece of content we deliver answers these questions, you’ll review content and provide writers with actionable feedback, from big-picture guidance down to inline edits. You’ll be dedicated to a specific pool of customers so you can get deeply familiar with their business and brand and provide feedback that takes into account their holistic strategy, not just each individual piece. 

Requirements

• 

Experience writing and editing diverse forms of content for B2B tech, especially long-form content (blog posts, ebooks, guides, etc.) 

• 

Working knowledge of SEO and AEO/GEO best practices. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should know the basics

• 

Ability to deliver actionable feedback. You can communicate why changes should be made, balancing candor with respect

• 

Ability to quickly get up to speed on new industries, companies, and products

• 

Knowledge of and interest in the B2B tech industry and content marketing trends and best practices

• 

Available 5-10 hours per week (schedule varies; you’ll be expected to deliver edits within 1 business day of receiving an assignment)

Nice to Have: 

• 

Experience working in-house at a B2B tech company

• 

Experience developing and executing content strategies 

• 

Experience as a manager, mentor, or coach for writers (formal or informal) 

Working Arrangements

Location: Fully remote (Americas or EMEA) 

Employment type: Freelancer

Rate: $65/hour

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/animalz-developmental-content-editor

a8152ecaa2f86215.description: **Only apply if: **You have 1–2 years of production full-stack experience, you have shipped live products end to end (interface, APIs, data, and deployment), and you can point us to URLs we can open today. **Who We Are** Steps AI is a product company building intelligent, AI-powered software for modern businesses. We design and ship production systems that combine strong user experience, reliable backends, and data-driven intelligence. We work with real customers, deploy to both cloud and on-premises environments, and move from prototype to production with a high bar for security, access control, and operational quality. We are growing, shipping every week, and looking for engineers who can own a problem end to end — interface, API, data, security, and deployment — rather than a single layer of the stack. **The Role** * We are hiring a Full-Stack SDE who can take a working product, demo, or prototype and turn it into a reliable, role-based, securely deployed application that real users can operate on. You will work across the frontend, backend APIs, database, and deployment — and you will be expected to raise the quality of design, access control, and operations as you go, not just add screens. * This is an individual-contributor role with real ownership. You will implement features from specification to production, participate in reviews, and support releases to cloud and on-premises environments. **What You Will Do** **Frontend** * Build production web applications in React and TypeScript (Next.js experience is a strong plus) with a clear, consistent UI. * Implement dashboards, tables, filters, forms, maps or geographic views, and multi-step workflows that stay usable under real data volumes. * Translate product requirements and design intent into responsive, accessible interfaces. You will make design decisions when a finished mock is not available. * Integrate the UI with backend APIs using disciplined client state, caching, error states, and loading behaviour. **Backend and APIs** * Design and implement REST APIs (Python/FastAPI or Node/TypeScript) with clear contracts, validation, and error handling. * Implement authentication and session handling (JWT, OAuth, or server sessions) and enforce authorization on every sensitive path. * Build workflow, notification, file, and reporting endpoints that are safe to expose in a multi-user system. * Write services that are observable: structured logs, meaningful status codes, and failure modes that operators can diagnose. **Database and Data** * Model relational data (PostgreSQL or equivalent), write migrations, and keep schemas versioned and reviewable. * Index, query, and paginate so list and analytics views stay fast as data grows. * Handle imports, exports, and data-quality checks without corrupting the system of record. * Participate in backup, restore, and environment-promotion practices for the data layer. **Security, RBAC, and Hardening** * Implement role-based access control so users only see and change what their role and scope allow. * Harden applications that began as demos: remove unsafe defaults, lock down admin paths, add audit trails, and treat secrets correctly. * Apply basic application security: input validation, CSRF/CORS discipline, password hashing, session expiry, least privilege. * Support secure configuration for on-premises installs (environment separation, TLS, controlled admin access). **Deployment and Operations** * Package and deploy the full application (web + API + database) using Docker and a documented release path. * Contribute to CI/CD, environment promotion (dev / staging / production), and rollback discipline. * Debug production issues across the stack instead of stopping at the layer you last touched. * Travel when needed to client or on-premises sites in Hyderabad to install, verify, or support a release. **Must-Have Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. * 2–4 years of professional software engineering with production systems in use by real users. * Proven ability to ship a feature across UI, API, and database — not only one of the three. * Strong TypeScript or modern JavaScript, and solid Python or Node on the server. * Working knowledge of relational databases, migrations, and query basics. * Practical experience with Git, code review, and collaborative branching. * Comfort with Docker-based local development and at least one CI/CD system. * Clear written communication: you can turn a product note into a technical plan without many clarification rounds. * Willingness to work on-site in Hyderabad and to travel to client or on-premises locations as required. * Next.js (App Router), TanStack Query, and a modern component system (for example shadcn/ui). * FastAPI or NestJS in production. * Experience adding RBAC, audit logs, or approval workflows to an existing application. * Maps, charts, or other data-heavy interfaces. * AI-assisted product features (assistants, retrieval, streaming UIs) as a consumer of APIs. * On-premises or restricted-network deployment experience. * Basic automated tests (unit, API, or Playwright/Cypress). **Location, Work Mode, and Travel** This is a full-time, on-site role in Hyderabad, India. You will work in person with the engineering team. Occasional travel is required. This includes travel to on-premises deployment locations and travel to client sites in Hyderabad for implementation, go-live, reviews, or production support. Travel is typically short-duration and planned; willingness to travel within Hyderabad (and occasionally nearby) is a condition of the role. **What We Offer** * Competitive salary with a clear growth path. Add salary range at posting. * High-ownership work: you will influence architecture, security, and how the product is shipped. * Exposure to AI-assisted products, enterprise-grade access control, and real production deployments. * Fast execution cycles and a culture that values demonstrated capability over credentials alone. * Learning budget for courses and certifications. * Collaborative in-office engineering culture in Hyderabad.

Description

Do you love to read? Are you inspired by how to make written content easy and delightful to consume on Kindle? If the answer is yes, you have the opportunity to inspire millions of customers to read more. Kindle is among the bestselling products in the history of Amazon, with a rich legacy for driving customer-focused innovation. Our continued growth requires leaders who operate both strategically and tactically; think big to drive new opportunities; dive deep in data to uncover customer insights; break down and solve complex problems; and drive operational excellence.

This position is for our Kindle Content Experience team, whose mission is to provide superior reading experience for all eBooks on Kindle devices and applications by partnering with publishers and authors. We strive to build and enhance mechanisms to enable publishers and authors create eBooks with the right layouts, typography and fonts for a great and coherent experience across devices.

As a Senior Product Manager (Technical), you will define, execute, and deliver a product roadmap with the goal of earning the trust of our publishers and authors to deliver the best experience for our reading customers. You will strongly influence the strategy and vision for the group. You will develop and look after product roadmaps and features based on team strategy and vision. This role is inherently cross-functional -- you will work closely with engineering, business, operations, vendor management and executive teams to launch features and build tools and mechanisms. A successful candidate will be highly analytical, able to work extremely effectively in a matrix organization, and adept at synthesizing a variety of technologies and capabilities into high quality, simple product, features and applications.

Key job responsibilities

• Assist in driving and delivering the best content experience on all Kindle surfaces.
• Lead cross-functional teams (engineering, UX, research, etc.) across Amazon and Books to deliver projects on time.
• Support in defining strategic, creative, high quality product roadmaps based on team strategy and vision supported by internal and external analysis.
• Learn from customer feedback, behavioral measurements, and other data sources to craft better experiences and ensure we are building the right features over time.
• Role is global in nature and will work with teams in other countries.

About The Team

The KINEX (Kindle Experience) team owns the overall experience for the Kindle for iOS app, Kindle for Android app, FireOS, E-reader, Kindle for web, PC/Mac, Kindle File Format for Books & Documents, Content Experiences and Publisher Tools. This includes much of the experience you see on the app (Library, Home, Settings, Insights, etc.) and inside of the book (Core content presentation, Audio books consumption, Aa menu, other chrome), but does not include Store detail page/search and the publishing and subscription side of the business (KDP, KU, etc.).

Our mission is to make Kindle the world's favorite way to read and get more out of reading. Our vision for Kindle is a magical piece of paper that empowers customers to engage with and reflect on the written word.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics
• 5+ years of professional experience with 2+ years of consumer/enterprise facing product management experience
• Experience working with cross-functional teams to deliver products and projects on tight deadlines
• Experience coordinating product development cycles and software development schedules

Preferred Qualifications

• MBA
